questions.prompt: A bug report arrives. What do you do first?
options: Reproduce it with a failing test
Ask for the module to be rewritten
questions.why: A failing test proves the bug exists, and later proves the fix worked.

wrong.0: Slow, and you do not yet know what to look for.
wrong.2: Without a failing test you cannot tell whether it worked.
wrong.3: A rewrite brings new bugs and cannot be reviewed.

questions.prompt: Your new test fails with "Cannot find module". What does that prove about the bug?
options: Nothing: the test fails for another reason
questions.why: The test never reached the code. Fix the import, then see whether it fails for the right reason.

wrong.0: It failed before it could check anything.
wrong.1: A missing import says nothing about the code's behaviour.
wrong.3: A test is finished when it fails because of the bug, and passes after the fix.

questions.prompt: GPIS D-70: House 1 has 12 pupils, House 2 has 9, House 3 has 9, House 4 has 11. Where does the new pupil go?
questions.why: Houses 2 and 3 have the fewest; the tie goes to the first name in alphabetical order.

wrong.0: That takes the last of the tie.
wrong.1: House 1 has the most pupils. Names only break a tie.

questions.prompt: GPIS D-48: in 2027 so far there are ADM/GPIS/2027/001 and /002; 150 numbers exist for 2026. What is the next number for 2027?
questions.why: NNN runs from 001 within the admission year. Only 2027 numbers count.

wrong.1: That counts the numbers of every year.
wrong.3: The year in the number is the admission year, 2027.

questions.prompt: GPIS D-46: how is the full name "Ama Serwaa Birikran" imported?
options: First "Ama", last "Serwaa Birikran", no middle name
questions.why: The first word is the first name, the rest is the last name, and the middle name stays empty.

wrong.0: D-46 leaves the middle name empty.
wrong.2: Only the first word is the first name.
wrong.3: Only a one-word name is a row error.

questions.prompt: While fixing a bug you see an ugly but working function next to it. What do you do?
options: Tidy it in the same commit
Leave it, and note it for later
questions.why: Stay inside the task. Say what you noticed; do not change it.

wrong.0: That hides the real change inside a bigger diff.
wrong.1: A rewrite is the riskiest change of all.
wrong.3: It works, and something may use it.
